basic_info.description: Welcome to Residence 66A at 181 Fremont Street, an exceptional offering within San Francisco's prestigious highrise community. Encompassing 2,404 square feet, this stunning 2 bedroom, 2  bath view home on the 66th floor home presents unrivaled North and East vistas, showcasing iconic landmarks like the Golden Gate Bridge, Bay Bridge, Alcatraz Island, and Mt. Diablo. Located in downtown San Francisco, it offers convenient access to major employers, cultural attractions, and premier dining. Adjacent to Salesforce Park and Transit Center, benefit from a seventh-floor sky bridge leading to a 5.4-acre beautifully landscaped urban retreat. Experience unparalleled luxury with exclusive amenities: full-time concierge and doorman services, a Residents' Club featuring open-air terraces with 360-degree views, elegant lounges, and a state-of-the-art gym with a private yoga studio. Additional features include smart home tech, high ceilings, hardwood floors, high-speed internet, custom walk-in closet, private entrance, and secure storage. This residence is the ultimate haven for the modern tech executive, combining convenience and luxury at one of San Francisco's most coveted addresses.
